question: In the passage, the word "ubiquitous" most nearly means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (2)** i.e. Present everywhere.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ubiquitous"** means present, appearing, or found everywhere. (सर्वव्यापी)

 
 
• **Example: **Smartphones have become ubiquitous in today's society.
 
 
 
• The closest meaning for **'ubiquitous'** is **'present everywhere'**, which indicates something that is commonly found or widespread. (हर जगह मौजूद)
 
 
• **Example: **The ubiquitous nature of the internet allows people to connect globally.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Present everywhere**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rare and isolated** (दुर्लभ और पृथक):

 
 
• **Example: **While once common, these plants are now rare and isolated in the wild.
 
 
 
• **Dependent on specific locations** (विशिष्ट स्थानों पर निर्भर):
 
 
• **Example: **Some businesses are dependent on specific locations to thrive, such as coastal cities for fishing industries.
 
 
 
• **Outdated and irrelevant** (पुराना और अप्रासंगिक):
 
 
• **Example: **Many once-popular technologies have now become outdated and irrelevant.
